description: Lock v6 / execution v5 proof bundles that must fail, for both tags (drand-quicknet+metoffice-landobs-v1 and drand-quicknet+elexon-freq-v1). Each case changes fields of a passing bundle (proof-bundle-v6*.json) and signs again with the keys in keys, so the signatures are valid over the bytes as written (cases that change only a wrapper key or the unsigned entropy are not re-signed); a changed lock also gets a recomputed, re-signed lock_receipt_hash. The seed, results and unsigned entropy are rebuilt from the changed execution receipt. expected_failing_steps is the exact set of verifier steps (snake_case) that fail; every other step passes or is skipped.
